title: The Martyrs Receive Gurbakhsh Singh in the Heavenly Court

blocks.text: The scene opens beyond the battlefield, where the martyr is welcomed by the Panth's earlier heroes. The great Singh martyr Mani Singh's spirit came himself, and Martyr Taru Singh come as well, reversing the loneliness of death by showing Gurbakhsh Singh received into a living fellowship of sacrifice.

Coming near, martyrs greeted Gurbakhsh Singh with honor, while the persecutors and executioners who had tormented the Sikhs appear humbled and powerless in that higher court. The page treats martyrdom not as annihilation but as entrance into a company that already knows the cost of fidelity.

Gurbakhsh Singh answers the welcome with intercession rather than self-congratulation. With folded hands did Gurbakhsh Singh pray to God for the Khalsa Panth which the Divine Guru had himself initiated, asking that the suffering community be protected and its enemies brought to ruin.
